turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{Operation?}

    B -->|Received document| C[ASSAY]
    B -->|Draft prompt or task| D[PROVIDE]

    subgraph ASSAY[ASSAY]
        C --> C1[Compress to floor content]
        C1 --> C2[Name evaporated content and function]
        C2 --> C3[Locate operative sentence]
        C3 --> C4[Report ratio and erosion direction]
        C4 --> C5[Flag missing rough edge]
        C5 --> C6[Report residue and finding]
        C6 --> C7[This is a finding, not a draft.]
    end

    subgraph PROVIDE[PROVIDE]
        D --> D1{Mode stated or inferable?}
        D1 -->|No| D2[Ask for mode]
        D2 --> D1
        D1 -->|Yes| D3[Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path]
        D3 --> D4{HUMAN mode?}
        D4 -->|Yes| D5[Run the speak test]
        D4 -->|No| D6[Continue]
        D5 --> D6
        D6 --> D7{Floor passes?}
        D7 -->|No, three gaps or fewer| D8[Ask one question naming the gaps]
        D7 -->|No, four gaps or more| D9[Ask three largest gaps]
        D9 --> D10[State assumptions for the rest]
        D8 --> D11[Wait for answer]
        D10 --> D11
        D11 --> D3
        D7 -->|Yes| D12[Compress the prompt]
        D12 --> D13[Cut context and constraints without floor loss]
        D13 --> D14{Cut removed specification?}
        D14 -->|Yes| D15[Revert destructive or decorative cut]
        D15 --> D12
        D14 -->|No| D16[Record Cut: nothing. when appropriate]
        D16 --> D17{Two consecutive empty cuts?}
        D17 -->|No| D18{Floor still passes?}
        D18 -->|No| D19[Return last passing version]
        D18 -->|Yes| D12
        D17 -->|Yes| D20[Contract is minimal]
        D19 --> D20
        D20 --> D21[Output optimized prompt]
        D21 --> G[Ask gate question]
    end

    G{Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?}
    G -->|Keep negotiating| D12
    G -->|Valid named human freezes| H[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    G -->|Invalid or ambiguous response| D12

    H --> I{Execution tools available?}
    I -->|No| J[Gate stays closed]
    I -->|Yes| K[Execute exactly as frozen]
    K --> L{Result}
    L -->|Success| M[Done]
    L -->|Floor item fails| N[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    N --> D12
```
